crossRefs.note: David said to Abigail, “Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me!

Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,
The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges…
After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation…
for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.

Now therefore, my lord, as Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, since Yahweh has withheld you from blood guiltiness…
For indeed, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, lives, who has withheld me from harming you, unless you had hurried and come…
Therefore behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and I will build a wall against her, that she can’t find her…
She will follow after her lovers, but she won’t overtake them; and she will seek them, but won’t find them. Then she…
Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable…
May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at…
And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory…
Afterward, when David heard it, he said, “I and my kingdom are guiltless before Yahweh forever of the blood of Abner…
Let it fall on the head of Joab, and on all his father’s house. Let there not fail from the house of Joab one who has a…
The king said moreover to Shimei, “You know in your heart all the wickedness that you did to David my father. Therefore…
So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the king’s wrath was pacified.
The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.
Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of Yahweh.
House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.
Who can find a worthy woman? For her price is far above rubies.
Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.

people.name: Abigail
people.line: Wife of Nabal, later married David

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Nabal
people.line: Wealthy Carmelite; husband of Abigail. He was known for foolishness.

translations.web: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, “Blessed is Yahweh, who has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and has kept back his servant from evil. Yahweh has returned the evildoing of Nabal on his own head.” David sent and spoke concerning Abigail, to take her to himself as wife.
translations.bsb: On hearing that Nabal was dead, David said, “Blessed be the LORD, who has upheld my cause against the reproach of Nabal and has restrained His servant from evil. For the LORD has brought the wickedness of Nabal down upon his own head.” Then David sent word to Abigail, asking her to become his wife.
translations.kjv: And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be the LORD, that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his servant from evil: for the LORD hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.
translations.asv: And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be Jehovah, that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept back his servant from evil: and the evil-doing of Nabal hath Jehovah returned upon his own head. And David sent and spake concerning Abigail, to take her to him to wife.
